LanguageData.Lumen_Info_WarpRule: This is a Warp active effect: it runs only while the fixture's Warp active effect is toggled on and the map has Warp energy.
LanguageData.Lumen_DarkInfo_SanguiniteRule: Treats colonists, slaves and prisoners resting in a bed in the same room. Only the strongest Sanguinite fixture in reach treats a patient, and bionics are never touched.
LanguageData.Lumen_DarkInfo_BleedingRateDesc: Wounds stay untended and keep bleeding, only slower.
LanguageData.Lumen_DarkInfo_ScarDesc: One scar per pass, for {0} Warp energy each.
LanguageData.Lumen_DarkInfo_RegrowDesc: Regrowth is paid gradually and pauses when the patient leaves bed or Warp energy runs out. Fingers and toes take {0} day and {1} Warp energy; eyes, ears, noses and jaws {2} days and {3}; internal organs {4} days and {5}.
LanguageData.Lumen_DarkInfo_DreadstoneReach: Only the strongest covering Dreadstone fixture counts.
LanguageData.Lumen_DarkInfo_SubjugationRule: Applies to the colony's prisoners and slaves in the same room.
LanguageData.Lumen_DarkInfo_PerPawnPerDay: Warp energy per pawn per day
LanguageData.Lumen_DarkInfo_DreadRule: Applies to hostile humanlikes in line of sight. Mechanoids and animals are immune. Nothing is spent with no hostiles in reach.
LanguageData.Lumen_DarkInfo_SiphonRule: When a weakened enemy dies, {0} of its market value returns as Warp energy.
LanguageData.Lumen_DarkInfo_HollowstoneRule: Applies to colonists and slaves in the same room. Work husks are not affected. Only the strongest Hollowstone fixture in reach counts.
